```{r setup}
library(conflicted)
library(tidyverse)
library(powerjoin)
library(here)
library(emmeans)
library(lme4)
library(synExtra)
library(ggbeeswarm)
library(patchwork)

conflicts_prefer(
  dplyr::filter,
  dplyr::count,
  generics::setdiff,
  dplyr::slice,
  dplyr::rename,
  purrr::reduce
)

theme_set(
  theme_minimal(base_family = "Helvetica")
)

synapser::synLogin()
syn <- synDownloader(normalizePath("~/data"), .cache = TRUE)
```

## Loading data

```{r}
te_by_sample <- syn("syn78684707") |>
  read_csv() |>
  mutate(
    Sample = factor(Sample),
    Group = factor(Group, levels = c("TDP43+", "TDP43-"))
  )

plot_dir <- here("dsrna", "plots")
```

## Total TE expression

Is overall TE expression higher in TDP43- nuclei?

```{r}
te_by_lib <- te_by_sample |>
  group_by(Sample, SRR, Group, size_factor) |>
  summarize(
    te_counts = round(sum(sum_raw_counts)),
    te_counts_norm = sum(sum_normalized_counts),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

mdl_total <- glmer.nb(
  te_counts ~ Group + offset(log(size_factor)) + (1 | Sample),
  data = te_by_lib
)
emmeans(mdl_total, revpairwise ~ Group, type = "response")$contrasts
```

## TE expression by family

```{r}
te_by_lib_family <- te_by_sample |>
  group_by(Sample, SRR, Group, TE_family, size_factor) |>
  summarize(
    te_counts = round(sum(sum_raw_counts)),
    te_counts_norm = sum(sum_normalized_counts),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

mdl_total <- glmer.nb(
  te_counts ~ Group * TE_family + offset(log(size_factor)) + (1 | Sample / TE_family) + (1 | SRR),
  data = te_by_lib_family
)

family_ratios_mdl <- emmeans(mdl_total, ~ Group | TE_family, type = "response") |>
  contrast(method = "revpairwise") |>
  update(by = NULL, adjust = "fdr") |>
  summary(infer = TRUE) |>
  as_tibble()

joint_tests(mdl_total, adjust = "fdr")

# This is the ratio of each family's TDP43 pathology effect relative
# to the average effect across all families
family_ror_mdl <- emmeans(mdl_total, ~ Group | TE_family) |>
  contrast(interaction = c("revpairwise", "eff"), by = NULL, adjust = "fdr") |>
  summary(infer = TRUE, type = "response") |>
  as_tibble() |>
  mutate(TE_family = str_remove_all(TE_family_eff, "^\\(|\\)? effect$"))
```

Gettig the observed per familly ratios

```{r}
family_ratios_obs <- te_by_lib_family |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Group, values_from = te_counts_norm,
    id_cols = c(TE_family, Sample)
  ) |>
  mutate(ratio = `TDP43-` / `TDP43+`)

family_order <- family_ratios_mdl |>
  arrange(ratio) |>
  pull(TE_family)

p_ratios <- ggplot(
  mapping = aes(
    x = factor(TE_family, levels = family_order)
  )
) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, color = "#898781", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_quasirandom(
    aes(y = ratio, fill = "Individual donors"),
    data = family_ratios_obs,
    width = 0.25, color = "gray"
  ) +
  geom_pointrange(
    aes(y = ratio, ymin = asymp.LCL, ymax = asymp.UCL, color = "GLMM estimate (95% CI)"),
    data = family_ratios_mdl
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(
      y = max(family_ratios_obs$ratio) * 1.05,
      label = paste0(
        sprintf("%.2f", ratio), "\n",
        if_else(
          p.value < 1e-4, "p<1e-4",
          paste0("p=", signif(p.value, 1))
        )
      )
    ),
    data = family_ratios_mdl,
    size = 2.8,
    lineheight = 0.9
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    trans = "log2",
    breaks = c(.9, 1, 1.1, 1.2, 1.3, 1.4)
  ) +
  # scale_x_discrete(expand = expansion(add = c(0.6, 1))) +
  coord_flip(clip = "off") +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "TE expression ratio TDP43- / TDP43+",
    color = NULL,
    fill = NULL,
    caption = "Liu et al."
  ) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_line(),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.justification = "center",
    legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0)
  )
p_ratios

ggsave(
  file.path(plot_dir, "te_family_ratio_quasirandom.pdf"),
  p_ratios, width = 6, height = 5
)
```

Each family's TDP43- / TDP43+ ratio relative to the average ratio across all
families. Values > 1 mean the family increases more than TEs
overall in TDP43- nuclei.

```{r}

family_ror_obs <- family_ratios_obs |>
  group_by(Sample) |>
  mutate(ror = ratio / exp(mean(log(ratio)))) |>
  ungroup()

p_ror <- ggplot(
  mapping = aes(
    x = factor(TE_family, levels = family_order)
  )
) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, color = "#898781", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_quasirandom(
    aes(y = ror, fill = "Individual donors"),
    data = family_ror_obs,
    width = 0.25, color = "gray"
  ) +
  geom_pointrange(
    aes(y = ratio, ymin = asymp.LCL, ymax = asymp.UCL, color = "GLMM estimate (95% CI)"),
    data = family_ror_mdl
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(
      y = max(family_ror_obs$ror) * 1.05,
      label = paste0(
        sprintf("%.2f", ratio), "\n",
        if_else(
          p.value < 1e-4, "p<1e-4",
          paste0("p=", signif(p.value, 1))
        )
      )
    ),
    data = family_ror_mdl,
    size = 2.8,
    lineheight = 0.9
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    trans = "log2",
    breaks = c(.8, .9, 1, 1.1, 1.2)
  ) +
  coord_flip(clip = "off") +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "TE ratio relative to average TE ratio TDP43- / TDP43+",
    color = NULL,
    fill = NULL,
    caption = "Liu et al."
  ) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_line(),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.justification = "center",
    legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0)
  )
p_ror

p_ratios_combined <- (
  (p_ratios + labs(caption = NULL)) +
    (p_ror + theme(axis.text.y = element_blank()))
) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
  theme(legend.position = "top")
p_ratios_combined

ggsave(
  file.path(plot_dir, "te_family_ratio_and_ror_quasirandom.pdf"),
  p_ratios_combined, width = 8, height = 4
)
```


## TE expression by genomic location

Same analysis as above, but aggregating TE counts by genomic location
instead of TE family.

```{r}
te_by_lib_location <- te_by_sample |>
  group_by(Sample, SRR, Group, Genomic_location, size_factor) |>
  summarize(
    te_counts = round(sum(sum_raw_counts)),
    te_counts_norm = sum(sum_normalized_counts),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(Genomic_location = factor(Genomic_location))

mdl_location <- glmer.nb(
  te_counts ~ Group * Genomic_location + offset(log(size_factor)) +
    (1 | Sample / Genomic_location) + (1 | SRR),
  data = te_by_lib_location
)

joint_tests(mdl_location)
```

TDP43- / TDP43+ ratio per genomic location.

```{r}
location_ratios_mdl <- emmeans(mdl_location, ~ Group | Genomic_location, type = "response") |>
  contrast(method = "revpairwise") |>
  update(by = NULL, adjust = "fdr") |>
  summary(infer = TRUE) |>
  as_tibble()

location_ratios_mdl

location_ratios_obs <- te_by_lib_location |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Group, values_from = te_counts_norm,
    id_cols = c(Genomic_location, Sample)
  ) |>
  mutate(ratio = `TDP43-` / `TDP43+`)
```

```{r}
location_ror_mdl <- emmeans(mdl_location, ~ Group | Genomic_location) |>
  contrast(interaction = c("revpairwise", "eff"), by = NULL, adjust = "fdr") |>
  summary(infer = TRUE, type = "response") |>
  as_tibble() |>
  mutate(
    Genomic_location = str_remove(Genomic_location_eff, " effect$") |>
      str_replace("^\\((.*)\\)$", "\\1")
  )

location_ror_mdl

location_ror_obs <- location_ratios_obs |>
  group_by(Sample) |>
  mutate(ror = ratio / exp(mean(log(ratio)))) |>
  ungroup()
```
